exif.title: Keep the photo's technical data?
exif.warning:
This photo carries invisible information: where it was taken (GPS), when, and with which device. Keeping it may help as evidence — but it also reveals where you were.

If you prefer to protect yourself, discard it: the photo still counts, without the technical data. Only specially authorized and audited staff can see kept data.
exif.anonymousWarning: You chose to report anonymously. This photo's technical data may reveal your location and contradict that anonymity. Keep it only if you understand this risk.
